How Refunds work

Link: https://example.com/refunds

The billing module allows the Admin to issue a refund for transactions completed through the site.

Disclaimer

Please contact the payment merchant about refund limits.

  • Some payment gateways do not permit refunds.
  • Some payment gateways require 24 hours before a refund.

How to Process a Refund?

Open the order and choose the refund action.

Confirm the amount, then submit.

  1. Open Billing.
  2. Select the paid order.
  3. Click Refund.
